summary: Pampa Energía S.A. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that its board approved a renewed general framework for engaging Sociedad Argentina de Construcción y Desarrollo Estratégico S.A. for engineering and construction services on projects planned over the next year. Terms mirror prior-year frameworks disclosed as Relevant Events in November 2018 through 2025; no price, stake, or securities are involved. The Audit Committee opined the related-party arrangement satisfies arm's-length standards under article 72 of Argentina's Capital Markets Law. This is a routine related-party services framework, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
